directory.rankingIntro: Businesses are ordered by how well they match what you asked for, and by signals that show they are reliable.

relevance.title: How well it matches

distance.text: Nearer businesses rank higher, measured from your chosen place or your location.

trust.title: Verification
trust.text: Businesses with more checks completed (phone, registration, address, authorised dealer) rank higher.

rating.title: Reviews
